map.(流动资产 − 存货) / 流动负债 使用指南: (Current Assets - Inventory) / Current Liabilities User Guide
map.输入流动资产、存货与流动负债，计算速动比率，剔除变现慢的存货后评估短期偿债能力，: Enter current assets, inventory and current liabilities to compute the quick ratio, which strips out slow-moving inventory to assess short-term solvency; it suits liquidity risk screening and supplier credit decisions.
map.速动比率 = (流动资产−存货)/流动负债: Quick ratio = (Current Assets - Inventory) / Current Liabilities
map.速动比率剔除存货后的短期偿债能力。: Quick ratio is short-term solvency after stripping out inventory.
map.在流动比率之外，剔除变现较慢的存货，看即时偿债能力。: Beyond the current ratio, strip out the slower-moving inventory to look at immediate repayment ability.
map.存货占比高的企业（如零售、地产），速动比率比流动比率更关键。: For businesses with a high inventory share (such as retail and real estate), the quick ratio matters more than the current ratio.
map.债权人审核短期头寸时，速动比率是更严苛的底线指标。: When a creditor reviews short-term position, the quick ratio is a stricter bottom-line measure.
map.：某公司流动资产 800 万元（其中存货 300 万元）、流动负债 400 万元: A company has current assets of 8,000,000 CNY (of which 3,000,000 is inventory) and current liabilities of 4,000,000 CNY, so the quick ratio = (8,000,000 - 3,000,000)/4,000,000 = 1.25, meaning quick assets excluding inventory still cover short-term liabilities 1.25 times.
map.由三因子求净资产收益率: Return on equity from three factors
map.通常包括货币资金、交易性金融资产、应收账款等可快速变现资产；保守口径还会剔除变现: Usually cash, trading financial assets, accounts receivable and other quickly realizable assets; a conservative definition also removes receivables whose realization is uncertain.
map.速动比率一定要≥1 吗？: Must the Quick Ratio Always Be >= 1?
map.≥1 表示速动资产足以覆盖短期负债，较安全；但强现金流行业（如快消）可低于 1: >=1 means quick assets cover short-term liabilities and is relatively safe; but industries with strong cash flow (such as fast-moving consumer goods) can sit below 1 and still be safe, so look at collection speed too.
